scenarios.name: tail_threshold
scenarios.what: 3-token prompt tail rides with the first block; several confident guesses fill by threshold in one step; STOP in block 2 stops the request before block 3

scenarios.name: aligned_wrong_guesses
scenarios.what: prompt is exactly one block (no tail); steps=4 (2 per step); two wrong guesses are rewritten by token-to-token edits

scenarios.name: short_prompt_edit_gate
scenarios.what: prompt shorter than a block (no prefill pass); steps=3; editing_threshold 0.95 blocks every rewrite, so wrong guesses stay; output cut at max_new_tokens mid-block

scenarios.name: delete
scenarios.what: a junk token guessed on the first step is deleted (T2T DELETE): the block shifts left and a fresh, non-original mask is padded at the end

scenarios.name: insert
scenarios.what: X guessed where Y belongs; once X's left neighbour is filled with something else it becomes INSERT: a mask opens in front of X and the block's last row is truncated

scenarios.name: insert_on_mask
scenarios.what: a mask row predicts INSERT on the first step: M2T writes it, the edit opens [new MASK, original MASK] and truncates the block's last (original) mask; max_post_steps=1, so the first head with only that new mask open is the final round

scenarios.name: pad_mask_final_zero
scenarios.what: max_post_steps=0 with a junk delete early: the mask padded at the block end is not original and stays unconfident, so the step whose M2T covers the last two original masks is final while it is still open, and the final round fills it anyway

scenarios.name: pad_mask_post_one
scenarios.what: pad_mask_final_zero's script with max_post_steps=1: post-steps count from the first head with no ORIGINAL mask, while the padded mask is still open, and that step is the final round

scenarios.name: post_steps_final_t2t
scenarios.what: max_post_steps=1: a junk guess is the last mask filled, so the next step is the final round and its DELETE is re-picked with DELETE/INSERT at -inf; the block exits on the post-step budget and needs a commit pass

scenarios.name: max_steps_exit
scenarios.what: max_steps_per_block=2 with unconfident guesses: each block stops with masks left, the next block decodes over them, and each needs a commit pass

scenarios.name: max_post_zero
scenarios.what: max_post_steps=0: the step whose M2T covers the last original mask is final; that mask predicts DELETE and is re-picked; exit on the post-step check, commit pass

scenarios.name: temperature_top_k1
scenarios.what: max_post_zero's script at temperature 0.7, top_k 1: the sampled path (x_s, p_s from the unfiltered softmax, the final-round M2T re-pick) with one candidate per draw

scenarios.name: temperature_top_p
scenarios.what: tail_threshold's script at temperature 1.3, top_p 0.02: nucleus filtering leaves one candidate per draw

scenarios.name: resample_one_position
scenarios.what: O1 and O2 rewrite each other once the block is otherwise complete; the repeated pre-edit state triggers the anti-loop resample with exactly one changed position, which takes the second choice F

scenarios.name: no_early_stop
scenarios.what: eos_early_stop=false: STOP in block 1, blocks 2 and 3 still decode (STOP after STOP) and emit nothing

scenarios.name: block32_default_geometry
scenarios.what: the shipped geometry: block 32, steps 32, an 8-token prompt tail, one decode block
